title: Blood Parameter Monitoring System
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY MEDICAL COMMAND.US ARMY HEALTH CONTRACTING ACTIVITY.W40M MRC0 WEST
detail_text: Medical Readiness Contracting Office, West, Joint Base San Antonio, Fort Sam Houston, Texas intends to award a Firm-Fixed-Price sole source contract to Terumo Cardiovascular Systems Corporation to provide the Brooke Army Medical Center’s Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery with 2 Blood Parameter Monitoring Systems with accessories. Award will be made on or about 30 Mar 2026. The primary NAICS code for the requirement is 339112 (Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing) with a size standard of 1,000 employees. This notice is neither a request for quotes nor a solicitation of offers; however, all responsible sources may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency for future requirements. NOTE: INTERESTED VENDORS, PLEASE RESPOND TO THIS NOTICE ON OR BEFORE 9 Mar 2026, 1000 AM CDT.
